exchange-use.name: exchange-use
exchange-use.when: Use when the role must send, view, reply, forward, search, or file Exchange mail.
exchange-use.template: Use the exchange-use skill, open the Exchange mailbox, <action>, {<field>: <value>, ...}
exchange-use.params: JSON-like object: no quotation marks around keys or values. Omit unused keys. Omit the {...} block when the action has no fields.
rules: target defaults to first email when omitted on view, reply, reply all, forward, delete, or flag.
recipient, cc, and bcc must be a lab role short name (manager, hr, accountancy, programmer) or the matching *@ndrtest.local address. Do not send to the current role.
Do not invent mailboxes outside the four lab roles.
Prefer send email, reply, and forward over view-only mailbox actions. Use attachment when a share file already exists in the day's story.
For send email, reply, reply all, forward, and save draft: set min_words to an integer from 500 to 800. Do not write a long body; at most one short outline sentence. The soldier expands the prose.
Do not put min_words on view, search, delete, move, flag, mark unread, or recipient/subject/path fields.

odoo-use.name: odoo-use
odoo-use.when: Use when the role must work in Odoo (Employees, Recruitment, Discuss, Calendar, Contacts, Surveys, To-do).
odoo-use.template: Use the odoo-use skill, log in to the Odoo system, use the <module> module, <operation>, {<field>: <value>, ...}
odoo-use.params: JSON-like object: no quotation marks around keys or values. Omit unused keys. Omit the {...} block when the operation has no fields.
rules: Do not mention playwright-browser in the task string; the odoo-use skill loads it.
Use only listed module and operation names.
Create and add operations need a unique name or job position; do not reuse a fixed demo name.
Prefer create, add, update, and post message over view-only module actions.
For post message: set min_words to an integer from 500 to 800. Do not write a long body; at most one short outline sentence. The soldier expands the prose.

smb-access.name: smb-access
smb-access.when: Use when the role must create, view, update, copy, move, rename, or delete files on the company SMB share.
smb-access.template: Use the smb-access skill, connect to the SMB shared directory, use <op> to <detail>, {<field>: <value>, ...}
smb-access.params: JSON-like object: no quotation marks around keys or values. Omit unused keys.
rules: Use POSIX paths that start with /Company_Data/. Do not emit UNC paths in the task string.
Every path must stay under an Allowed SMB tree or SMB task path listed in context.env for this role.
Do not write to another role's private folder.
<detail> is a short phrase that restates the op (view a folder, create a file, download a file). Do not add extra semantics.
For create file prefer a .docx path with topic and min_words. The soldier writes a Word document about that topic and uploads it to the share. Do not write the document body in the task string.
Prefer create file, copy, download, and append over view-only folder listing.
For create file, append, and update file: set min_words to an integer from 500 to 800. Do not write a long content value; at most one short topic sentence.
create file write paths should end in .docx (preferred), or .txt, .md, or .csv. append and update file stay on .txt, .md, or .csv.
Use copy to place a .docx onto Exchange or Public (share-to-share). Use download to copy a share file onto the local Desktop.

ftp-use.name: ftp-use
ftp-use.when: Use when the role must list, upload, download, or delete files on the company FTPS server.
ftp-use.template: Use the ftp-use skill, connect to the FTPS server, use <op> to <detail>, {<field>: <value>, ...}
ftp-use.params: JSON-like object: no quotation marks around keys or values. Omit unused keys.
rules: Use POSIX paths that start with /ftp-root/. Stay under the FTP task path listed in context.env for this role.
Do not write to another role's FTP folder.
<detail> is a short phrase that restates the op (list a folder, upload a file, download a file). Do not add extra semantics.
Prefer upload and download over list-only folder listing.
For upload: set min_words to an integer from 500 to 800. Do not write a long content value; at most one short topic sentence. The soldier expands the prose and uploads it.
Do not put min_words on list, download, create folder, delete file, delete folder, or path fields.

playwright-browser.name: playwright-browser
playwright-browser.when: Use when the role must browse the public web or visit a non-OWA, non-Odoo URL. Do not use for Exchange or Odoo.
playwright-browser.template: Use the playwright-browser skill, open the browser, then execute: 1. <op>[, {key: value}] 2. <op>[, {key: value}] ... Verify: <observable result> Close the browser after verification.
playwright-browser.params: JSON-like objects: no quotation marks around keys or values. Shared optional fields: name, role, nth, url, query, text, key, path, direction, amount, timeout_seconds.
rules: Write the entire numbered list on one line inside the task string. Do not insert raw newlines.
Every playwright task must include at least four numbered ops, a Verify: clause, and Close the browser after verification.
Never use Google. Never open OWA or Odoo URLs with this skill.
After search, prefer follow with nth, then scroll, extract.
Do not invent in-page control names for unknown public sites.
Do not emit REPLACE_ tokens or other placeholders.
